short.en: Single Sign-On (OpenID Connect / OAuth 2.0 with PKCE S256) authentication for GLPI.
short.pt: Autenticação Single Sign-On (OpenID Connect / OAuth 2.0 com PKCE S256) para o GLPI.

long.en: Integrates GLPI 10, 11, and 12 with OpenID Connect and OAuth 2.0 identity providers (Microsoft Entra ID, Keycloak, Google Workspace, Okta, Authentik) using Authorization Code Flow with PKCE S256, anti-SSRF endpoint validation, AES-256-GCM secret encryption at rest, and audit logging.
long.pt: Integra o GLPI 10, 11 e 12 com provedores de identidade OpenID Connect e OAuth 2.0 (Microsoft Entra ID, Keycloak, Google Workspace, Okta, Authentik) utilizando Authorization Code Flow com PKCE S256, validação anti-SSRF de endpoints, segredo cifrado em repouso com AES-256-GCM e trilha de auditoria.
